meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把代码审查意见压成一行一条:行号、问题、修复建议。去掉「我觉得」「也许」等客套话,只留具体位置和可操作意见;遇到安全漏洞、架构分歧等会改用正常段落说明。
howto.when: 当你说「review this PR」「code review」等,或调用 /caveman-review,或在审查 pull request 时自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 格式 review 这个 PR

say.text: 按 caveman-review 风格审查这段代码

howto.what_en: Claude turns code review into ultra-compressed one-liners: 'L<line>: problem. fix.' It strips filler, keeps line numbers and names. For security, architecture, or onboarding, it writes a normal paragraph instead.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review this PR', 'code review', etc., invoke /caveman-review, or auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.text: Review this PR in caveman-review format.
say_en.note: Claude will output terse per-line comments.

say_en.text: Give concise code review comments on this diff.
Review this code with location, problem, and fix.
